description: React component for displaying a single image with preview, thumbnail check, modal preview, and embed toggle functionality in Mattermost.

classes.name: SingleImageView
classes.description: React component for rendering a single image with preview, thumbnail validation, and modal display.

methods.name: checkThumbnailAvailability
methods.description: Probes the thumbnail URL to determine if the thumbnail is rejected by a plugin.

methods.name: getDerivedStateFromProps
methods.description: Updates component state based on new props, particularly image dimensions.

methods.name: imageLoaded
methods.description: Sets the loaded state to true when the image has finished loading.

methods.name: handleImageClick
methods.description: Opens the file preview modal when the image or filename is clicked.

methods.name: toggleEmbedVisibility
methods.description: Toggles the visibility of the embedded image preview.

methods.name: getFilePublicLink
methods.description: Retrieves the public link for the file if enabled.
